items.title: My son does not work, yet pays $500 for Affordable Care Act health insurance. Is that fair?
items.description: “I see people who have a lot of money but little or no taxable income who still qualify for ACA Marketplace subsidies.”

items.title: I hold my mother-in-law’s power of attorney. I’m also her executor and trustee. Do I have too much power over her affairs?
items.description: “There is a lot of legal and financial power in my hands.”
